species.Description: Species that was imaged in this data set

sex.Description: sex of the participant as reported by the participant

gender.Description: gender of the participant as reported by the participant

handedness.Description: handedness of the participant as reported by the participant

drug_ses-01.Description: Drug allocation of the participant at the first session

Levels.Placebo: Participant received placebo on the first study day.
Levels.Verum: Participant received verum (90 mg DMT + 120 mg harmine) on the first study day.

drug_ses-02.Description: Drug allocation of the participant at the second session

Levels.Placebo: Participant received placebo on the second study day.
Levels.Verum: Participant received verum (90 mg DMT + 120 mg harmine) on the second study day.

blood_glucose_ses-01.Description: Blood glucose level of the participant at the first session as average of 2 measurements (before and after the scan)

blood_glucose_ses-02.Description: Blood glucose level of the participant at the second session as average of 2 measurements (before and after the scan)
